guard: an emitter publishes to the channel derived from its endpoint's allocated principal, and to nothing a caller, a record or a write-ahead log can name
why: This plane is defined to carry tool inputs and outputs, so which subject a session publishes
to is an authorization question rather than a routing detail. The manager mints a publish
grant for exactly one channel. A session that could be talked into publishing somewhere else
would either be silently unauthorized, which reads as a working system with an empty panel, or
authorized onto a channel whose name a reader trusts to identify its author.
WHAT THE CELLS ASSERT IS AN ABSENCE, so the endpoint instrument records the channel of every
publish rather than only its parts. A recorder that discards the channel can testify to
nothing about which channel was used.
SPECIFIER BOUNDARY, checked rather than assumed. The suite imports the emitter by relative
source path (../src/agui.js), and agui.ts reaches eventChannelForSession by relative source
path (./launch.js), so the bytes mutated are the bytes graded. No dist is in that chain and no
build is in the command. Its package-name imports are eventChannel and principalKey from
@cotal-ai/core, used by the CELLS to state the expected answer and deliberately not mutated:
a mutation there would move the assertion and the subject together and could not fail.
